description: After raising $200M in February... we raised another $445M in July! Your favorite computer company is capitalized to the gills--enough to weather the supply chain upheaval even! Come for co-founders Steve and Bryan describing the raise; stay for tax, debt, and credit talk with Scott Orn. In addition to Bryan Cantrill and Adam Leventhal, our special guests were Steve Tuck and Scott Orn. Previously, on Oxide and Friends: OxF s06e05 - Oxide's $200M Series C OxF s05e24 - Oxide's $100M Series B Some of the topics we hit on, in the order that we hit them: Oxide blog: Our $445M Series D Hacker News: Our $445M Series D Hacker News: Oxide Computer raises $445M (SEC Form D) If we got something wrong or missed something, please file a PR! Our next show will likely be on Monday at 5p Pacific Time on our Discord server; stay tuned to our Mastodon feeds for details, or subscribe to this calendar. We'd love to have you join us, as we always love to hear from new speakers!
title: Oxide's $445M Series D
